Only downloads image assets when asset_types filter is set

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"asset_types\":[\"image\"],\"download_assets\":true}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.statusCode())
debugPrint(result.assets().count)
debugPrint(result.assets()[0].assetCategory())
```
